chunks: The people of Al-Hijr denied Our aposts;
ai.seo_question: Who were the people of Al-Hijr and what did they do to the messengers?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the specific historical context of the Thamud tribe, who were known for carving dwellings into mountains, symbolizing their arrogance and reliance on material strength over spiritual submission. The narrative serves as a timeless warning against the rejection of divine messengers, emphasizing that denial leads to inevitable divine retribution.
